strings.Casco, arnés, cuerda y sistema planteado: Helmet, harness, rope and system raised.
strings.Control, posicion, comunicación y confia: Control, position, communication and trust in the system. Rappelling is not about running: it is about making it clear and reviewed.
strings.Error de maniobra, golpe, péndulo, quema: Maneuver error, bump, pendulum, rope burn, falling objects and poor communication.
strings.Lluvia, viento, roca inestable, calor, m: Rain, wind, unstable rock, heat, poor reception, emotional blockage or incompatible group.
strings.Personas que quieren aprender técnica ve: People who want to learn basic vertical technique calmly and with attention to detail.
strings.Ropa cómoda, calzado cerrado, pelo recog: Comfortable clothing, closed shoes, hair up, water and hands free.
strings.Con un centro especializado colaborador: With a partner specialist centre qualified in the discipline.
